page.overview:
Who is Casimir Gavendale?

is a former member of the Torn Banner, a smuggler, a member of the Crow Keepers thieves' guild in Dol-Makjar, and an indirect participant in the plot to save the life of Thjazi Fang. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Loza Blade described Casimir as the quiet type. Years later, however, he had become more blunt and impatient.

Casimir was a young mercenary in the Torn Banner, working in the mess hall. There, he became friends with Thjazi Fang, who convinced him to join the rebellion, in which he saved the orc's life at one point during a battle. Later, he became a smuggler and member of the Crow Keepers thieves' guild. After some time he started resenting his participation in the Falconer's Rebellion, since his life hadn't become much better despite the promises of the rebels.

By the year 63 he was still in touch with Thjazi and told him about rumors he heard regarding other falconers.
